tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: thugs dam zab pa skor bdun las: rdo rje mkha' 'gro gdugs dkar gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

rtsa gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: rtsa gsum tshe yi zab pa las: rdo rje mkha' 'gro gdugs dkar gyi: sgrub thabs snying por dril ba bstan: dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng: bum pa chas dang ldan pa'i nang: bdud rtsi lnga dang nyer lnga'i rdzas: yan lag brgyad ldan chu yis bkang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsham: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags nas: bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad mchod byin rlabs: chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang: rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab steng: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs lte ba la: pad+ma zla ba'i steng du oṃ: yongs gyur rdo rje gdugs dkar mo: g.yas pas rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang: g.yon pas zhags pa gdugs dkar brten: shar du de bzhin gdugs smug mo: lho ru rin chen gdugs ser mo: nub tu pad+ma gdugs dmar mo: byang du las kyi gdugs nag mo: rang rtags dbyug pa 'dzin pa sogs: khro mo'i chas can gtso dang mtshungs: sangs rgyas rigs lngas dbu brgyan cing: sgo bzhir rgyal chen sde bzhi dang: khyams la gtsang ris dpal mgon bcas: kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐: thugs srog las ni 'od 'phros pas: ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa dang: 'og min gnas dang dga' ldan nas: rdo rje lha mo 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du: 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs su gsol: de bzhin gshegs ma gdugs dkar la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: na mo na mā mi: hūm̐: rnam lnga la sogs phyi yi mchod pa dang: sman raka gtor gsum nang gi mchod pa dang: ye shes sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams: rdo rje gdugs dkar lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da kā ma gu ṇa pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta ta na gha ṇa pū dza ho:

hūm̐: de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing: phyir zlog chen mo bcom ldan rig sngags rgyal: 'jig rten dbang phyug gtsug gis zhabs la gtugs: rigs lnga mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas la bstod: thugs kar nyi steng oṃ gyi mthar: sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: rgyal mchod byin rlabs thams cad bsdus: 'gro sgrib sbyangs nas sangs rgyas kyi: sa la bkod nas snang srid kun: rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs su gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'bum phrag bdun bzlas las kun 'grub: slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer las: mtshon cha rnam lnga spros nas su: 'khor lo rim pa drug gis gtams: khro mo'i sprul pa nam mkha' gang: srung ba'i phrin las mdzad par bsam: oṃ si tā ta pa tre sarba gra ha na trā sa ya trā sa ya ha na ha na drūṃ drūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: 'bum bzlas srung ba'i las kun 'grub: slar yang khro mo'i sprul pa yis: byad ma lha srung bcas pa rnams: rdo rje'i zhags pas bcings nas su: rdo rje tho bas brdung ba dang: phur bus btab cing phyag rgyas mnan: gzungs sngags bzlas shing dmod pa bya: mthar ni mchod bstod gsol ba btab: snang srid 'od zhu rang la bstim: rang yang dmigs med ngang du bzhag: slar yang lha yi nga rgyal bya: dge ba bsngo zhing spyod lam bskyang: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa ni: dkyil 'khor bsham zhing mchod bstod bya: slob mas yon phul gsol ba btab: rgyud sbyang byin dbab brtan par bya: oṃ: bum pa rin chen gzhal yas khang: nang du gdugs dkar lha tshogs bzhugs: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: slob mar khrus byas dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ā: bla ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar: snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems: slob ma'i lce la bzhag pa yis: bde chen gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: sngags mthar: gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:

hūm̐: slob ma rdo rje dpa' bo yis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sbyor bas: dga' bzhi'i ye shes rtogs nas su: shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: sngags mthar: ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab dbyer med par: zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes ni: rdul bral mkha' ltar rnam par dag: mkha' ltar mnyam pa'i dbang thob shog: sngags mthar: dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: slob mas dam tshig khas blang zhing: yon phul dge ba bsngo bar bya: sa ma ya: byad dang rbod gtong bkrol ba ni: slob ma re ba'i gdan la bzhag: byad thag gis bcings sāts+tshas mnan: gtor ma changs bu brgya rtsa brgyad: sam+bha ra yis glud kyis bsngo: hūm̐: byad dang rbod gtong gtong ba'i bdag: lha dang mkha' 'gro 'byung po'i tshogs: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad dang rbod gtong bkrol nas kyang: zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par gyis: gzungs sngags bzla zhing thun gyis bskrad: 'bum gyis bsgrubs pa'i chu yis bkru: hūm̐: sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs dang: dam chos rnams kyi bden pa dang: dge 'dun rnams kyi bden tshig dang: bcom ldan rdo rje gdugs dkar gyi: rig sngags zab mo'i mthu stobs kyis: byad dang rbod gtong dag gyur cig: sngags kyi mthar/ lus ngag yid gsum phyes phyes khrol khrol: bcings pa dang mnan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: sāts+tsha bshig cing ral gri ni: sngags dang me chus ngar btab pas: bden stobs gzungs sngags bzlas pa'i mthar/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas byad thag re gdan gtubs: dgra gzugs bcas pa hom du bcug: bden stobs gzungs sngags sham bu sgyur: byad dang rbod gtong thams cad phur bus btab bo: tho bas brdung ngo: phyag rgyas mnan no: zhes brjod drag po'i me hom du: khro mo shin tu khros par bskyed: byad gtad zhal du bstab pa yis: dmigs med klong du bsregs par bsam: bden stobs sngags mthar

dz+wa la raṃ: zhes pas thun rdzas dang bcas bsreg: khro mo 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam: bsgrub byas me la lan bdun 'goms: khrus chu'i gzugs la spo ba'i tshul: ku sha rma bya'i sgro yis g.yab: a pa na ye sogs kyis byab: thal ba khrus chu 'bab chur dor: gnas rnams rak+ṣa sa rdo rjes gtams: byad gtad rnams las grol bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: byad dang rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phyir: 'bru nag khrag sbrus bshos bu ni: zur gsum lha grangs mnyam pa bsham: thun rdzas dar nag mtshon chas brgyan: byin rlabs gtor ma lha ru bskyed: spyan drangs mchod bstod bzlas pa bya: dgra bgegs bsgral zhing zhal du bstab: hūm̐: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku: rdo rje khro mo gdugs dkar mo: rdo rje'i rigs kyi dmod pa zlogs: de bzhin khro mo gdugs sngon mo: sangs rgyas rigs kyi dmod pa zlogs: rin chen khro mo gdugs ser mo: rin chen rigs kyi dmod pa zlogs: pad+ma khro mo gdugs dmar mo: pad+ma'i rigs kyi dmod pa zlogs: karma khro mo gdugs nag mo: las kyi rigs kyi dmod pa zlogs: rgyal chen gtsang rigs thams cad kyis: 'jig rten dmod pa thams cad zlogs: gzhan yang dmod pa gang shes bya: lha rnams rang la bstims nas su: gtor ma khro mo'i dmag tshogs su: bsgyur nas dgra bo'i phyogs su 'phang: byad ma rbod gtong bzlogs par bsam: dkyil 'khor rjes bsdu gzhung bzhin bya: byad kha rbod gtong bzlog par 'gyur: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bod la ru bzhi'i dgra dar nas: ngan sngags byad gtad byung ba'i tshe: man ngag 'di bstan bzlogs par byas: 'dir ni snying po bsdus te bkod: ma 'ongs chos byed yon mchod la: byad rbod zlog pa'i thabs su bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
